summary: sysdiagd 1.2.3: traced content withheld by safety filter, no corroborated installer-harm fingerprint
details: Package sysdiagd version 1.2.3 on PyPI was examined but no concrete installer-harm fingerprint (hardcoded C2 endpoint, credential-path read, home-directory secret scan, wallet/browser store enumeration, install-time fetch-and-execute, backdoor listener) is cited in the available evidence for this version. The traced file contents triggered a provider safety filter, which is a corroborating signal that the code may resemble operational malware patterns, but without a named behavior, file, destination, or data flow, the specific nature and reachability of any harmful code path cannot be stated.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
